description: Quran Vision Corpus (v6.2.1) is an open-access bilingual (Turkish / English) academic corpus and interactive foresight cockpit featuring 15 foundational Quranic verse reports (QV-2026-001 to QV-2026-015). Every monograph integrates 76 primary classical Arabic tafsir citations (ISNAD 2nd Edition verified) with 45 contemporary empirical datasets (APA 7 / DOI: World Bank, UNDP, WJP, UNESCO, SIPRI, OECD, WHO), 10-year Bayesian policy simulations (2026–2036), falsifiable early-warning thresholds, and 40-minute competency-based seminar/classroom debate lesson plans.
